question: Find the altitude (in cm) of side MT of triangle MNT with side MN = 36 cm, MT = 36 cm and NT = 48 cm.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

In isosceles ΔMNT, the altitude to the unequal side NT (48 cm) bisects it into two 24 cm segments.

Height to side NT = √(36² − 24²) = √720 = 12√5 cm.

Area of ΔMNT = 1/2 × 48 × 12√5 = 288√5 cm².

Equating area for base MT: 1/2 × 36 × Altitude = 288√5 cm².

Altitude to MT = (288√5 × 2) ÷ 36 = 16√5 cm.

**∴ The correct answer is 16√5 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Sides of ΔMNT: MN = 36 cm, MT = 36 cm, and NT = 48 cm.
